baseline_record.why: The unit's material setup consumes active ColorOverlay lighting and color fields and translates them into additional fighter TEV stages.

reason: Both guarded overlay consumers establish the relation.

baseline_record.why: The unit allocates TEV registers, uploads texture-expression constants, constructs HSD_TevDesc values, and installs the resulting hardware combiner stages during fighter material setup.

reason: Register uploads and stage construction verify the relation. Duplicate endpoint records are preserved separately.

baseline_record.why: The fighter material callback and color-overlay helper explicitly inspect fp->is_metal and select Metal-specific material and color resources for rendering.

reason: Active is_metal branches prove rendering participation, not transformation creation; tint common-table use has further guards.

baseline_record.why: The function obtains the fighter's active ColorOverlay, consumes its enabled primary color, and applies that color through a newly configured material TEV stage.

reason: Guarded overlay selection and stage submission establish this relation.

baseline_record.why: The function allocates TEV color registers, uploads its tint constants, maps those registers to combiner inputs and konst selectors, and installs one explicit HSD TEV stage.

reason: Relation is valid. Wording should explicitly say it conditionally installs at most one stage, not one on every invocation.

baseline_record.why: When fp->is_metal is active under the status-material selection flags, the function selects the dedicated common-color entry used by its fighter tint stage.

reason: Retain the Metal rendering relation, not the explanation as an exhaustive condition. Proposed wording correction: with clear x2223_b3 and both status-material flags, is_metal selects candidate index 4; the common entry is actually read only with clear x2223_b2 and disabled overlay color. Other branches select a fighter color or composite. No new link is proposed.

baseline_record.why: The unit's custom fighter material setup uploads fighter and overlay colors into TEV registers and adds TEV stages that combine those values with existing material and raster inputs.

reason: Lighting stage uses raster alpha and previous color. Duplicate relationship remains separately reviewed.

baseline_record.why: The function uploads a light-overlay constant into an allocated TEV color register and configures a new combiner stage that uses that register, raster alpha, and the previous stage color.

reason: All stated operations occur on the eligible branch.

baseline_record.why: The callback explicitly checks fp->is_metal and substitutes the dedicated ft_804D6580 material before configuring the fighter's render state.

reason: Guarded material substitution directly proves rendering participation.

baseline_record.why: During normal fighter material setup, the callback invokes the lighting-overlay and color-overlay helpers with the active Fighter and selected material.

reason: Ordered helper calls and their overlay consumers verify this relation.

baseline_record.why: The callback resets TEV state, invokes the material's virtual TEV setup, and then adds fighter-specific TEV augmentation through its two overlay helpers before committing render state.

reason: Normal-path order matches; helper augmentation is conditional.

baseline_record.why: The section's HSD_TevDesc and HSD_TECnst templates are copied, assigned hardware color registers and combiner selectors, and submitted as additional TEV stages by the fighter material helpers.

reason: Source template consumption is visible; compiled section identity and adjacency are unproved.

baseline_record.why: The data-backed fighter material class and its templates are consumed to translate the active fighter ColorOverlay's light and tint colors into rendering stages.

reason: Function-level relationship is established, compiled section attribution is not.

baseline_record.why: The setup callback installed in the section's ftMObj class object selects a dedicated material when `fp->is_metal` is active, while its template-driven color stage also selects the Metal-specific common color.

reason: Metal-sensitive branches are verified, but section membership is unproved and actual common-color use has additional guards.

baseline_record.why: The routine traverses a fighter model and directly changes the diffuse color used by every available HSD material.

reason: Retain the material-rendering relation. Proposed wording correction: every valid material reached by the instance-pruned traversal, not every available material in the complete hierarchy. No new link is proposed.

baseline_record.why: Mr. Game & Watch's load callback supplies a GAMEWATCH_COLOR entry indexed by costume ID, and the target applies that selected palette color throughout his model.

reason: Canonical caller proves costume-indexed diffuse recoloring. Proposed wording correction: applies to reached materials, excluding descent into instance children; actual palette bytes and named-color ordering remain unresolved.
